check.contract: Query result contract Only the first row is read. Several rows, a missing declared column or a wrong type count as a failed check, and the node stays open. satisfied 1 / 0 or true / false. True completes the action. out_<name> Converted to the declared type and written to the process variable. missing Reason codes when not satisfied, comma-separated, e.g. CASE_NOT_APPROVED. How it runs Checked once as soon as the node starts Then rechecked automatically every 5 minutes The follower can click "Check now" at any time The assignee is a follower: there is no Complete button; the system completes it once satisfied Once satisfied it isn't reopened if the data later changes; each business system still controls its own transactions.
